name: CresGarurumon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Activate 1 of the effects below.
・Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose play costs add up to 6 or less and return them to the bottom of their owner's deck.
・ Digivolve 1 of your other Digimon into a level 6 or lower Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name in your hand without paying its cost.
・This Digimon and another of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Omnimon] in its name, return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to the bottom of their deck.
